title: Oura Ring fails to sync with app
shortDescription: Ring data does not upload to Oura app over Bluetooth.
fullDescription:
Oura Ring transfers overnight data via Bluetooth LE when the app is opened. Sync failures stem from Bluetooth drops, permissions, or a ring with low battery. Keep the ring within a few feet of the phone and pull down to refresh.

If sync consistently fails, force-close the app, restart the phone, and ensure the Oura app has Bluetooth and background refresh permissions.

fixSteps.title: Force close app
fixSteps.instruction: Close Oura app fully and reopen.

fixSteps.title: Charge ring
fixSteps.instruction: Place on charger; retry sync once >20%.

title: Oura Ring battery critical / shorter than expected life
shortDescription: Ring battery dies within a day instead of 4-7 days.
fullDescription: Oura batteries should last 4-7 days. Shorter life can be caused by firmware updates, GPS-adjacent activity tracking, or an aging cell. Keep firmware current and monitor battery health in the app. Batteries are not user-replaceable.

fixSteps.title: Wait 1 week
fixSteps.instruction: Post-update re-indexing often settles within a week.

title: Oura Ring charger not working
shortDescription: Charging puck's LED does not light or ring does not take charge.
fullDescription: Oura's wireless charging puck uses USB-C input. Failure modes include bad USB-C cable, low-output charger, or debris on the pogo pins inside the puck. Use a 1A+ USB-C power source and clean the puck interior with a dry brush.

fixSteps.title: Clean puck
fixSteps.instruction: Brush inside of puck with dry toothbrush.

fixSteps.title: Replace cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use a known-good USB-C data cable.

title: Oura heart rate data has gaps overnight
shortDescription: Overnight HR graph has missing sections.
fullDescription: Oura uses infrared PPG sensors on the inner finger. Gaps usually mean the ring rotated off center, the finger was cold, or sensor window is dirty. Make sure the sensors (three green/IR dots) face the palm side of your finger.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe inside of ring with dry cloth.

title: Oura firmware update fails to complete
fullDescription: Firmware is transferred over BLE while the ring is on the charger and the app is open. Failures usually mean the ring moved off the puck, phone went to sleep, or Bluetooth dropped. Keep phone unlocked and ring stationary.

fixSteps.title: Keep on charger
fixSteps.instruction: Leave ring on puck, phone awake, app open.

fixSteps.title: Retry in app
fixSteps.instruction: Oura app > Settings > Check for Update.

title: Oura Ring fit causing inaccurate data
shortDescription: Ring too loose or too tight — data quality suffers.
fullDescription: Oura recommends snug fit with slight resistance over the knuckle. Loose ring rotates, creating sensor gaps. Tight ring restricts blood flow and affects SpO2. Use the sizing kit before purchase or exchange within 30 days.

fixSteps.title: Measure with kit
fixSteps.instruction: Wear sizing kit ring 24h before ordering.

fixSteps.title: Exchange
fixSteps.instruction: Within return window, exchange for correct size.

title: Oura Ring scratched after short use
fullDescription: Oura Ring's PVD-coated titanium finish is scratch-resistant but not scratch-proof. Minor scratches are cosmetic and don't affect function. Switch hands or remove during heavy-grip activities (weightlifting) to minimize wear.

fixSteps.title: Remove for lifting
fixSteps.instruction: Take off for weightlifting or heavy grip.

title: Oura cannot establish temperature baseline
shortDescription: No temperature deviation data — baseline incomplete.
fullDescription: Oura needs 14-30 nights to establish a temperature baseline. Until then, body temp deviation shows as pending. Consistent nightly wear is required; skipping nights extends the baseline period.
